candidates.source_title: The Tallest Family Stood Beside Robert Wadlow… The Height Difference Was Incredible! 😱
candidates.source_description: What happened when one of England’s tallest families stood beside Robert Wadlow, the tallest person ever recorded? 😲 Even the tallest members of the family looked surprisingly small next to his extraordinary height. From the youngest child to the parents and their tallest son, everyone appeared amazed by the incredible difference.
